summary: A claim reads as held while a grant it relies on is held for judgment

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes; cached verdicts and links are read as before.

schema.detail: No storage schema, index or digest changes; the new read uses the existing claim_verdict_links claim index and primary key.

rules.detail: claim_verdict and the verdict counts now read a claim as held (signature-judgment-incomplete) while any delegation it links is itself held: dirty, incomplete, blocked, judged on fewer candidates than it has, or waiting for a requeue. Before, a grant whose own nonce or candidates changed left its dependents reading their cached verdict until the grant was judged again (#4527). Final verdicts are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Read-side only and local to each member: nothing new is written, replicated or signed, so mixed-version fleets with the previous release interoperate unchanged; an older member keeps its older, shorter hold window.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal binary restart.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back requires no data migration.
